bio: Chairman of the Ways and Means Committee. Previously chaired the Budget Committee. Focused on tax policy and healthcare cost reduction through market-based reforms. Represents rural southeastern Missouri.
Senior member and Vice Chair. Strong advocate for Medicare reform and prescription drug pricing transparency. Has pushed legislation on surprise medical billing and mental health parity.

Chairs the Health Subcommittee. Leads healthcare policy for the committee including Medicare physician payment reform, telehealth expansion, and rural healthcare access. Represents rural western Nebraska.
Senior committee member focused on employer-sponsored health insurance, health savings accounts, and reducing regulatory burden on healthcare providers.
Advocates for healthcare innovation and technology-driven solutions. Strong proponent of price transparency and health data interoperability. Known for floor speeches on healthcare cost drivers.
Focused on rural healthcare access, mental health funding, and substance abuse treatment programs. Co-chair of the Congressional Mental Health Caucus.
Previously chaired the Budget Committee. Focused on Medicare solvency, Medicaid reform, and reducing federal healthcare spending. Represents Lubbock and west Texas.
Former Kansas State Treasurer. Focused on health savings accounts, association health plans, and small business healthcare affordability.
Focused on healthcare workforce development, site-neutral payment policies, and reducing hospital consolidation's impact on costs in Pennsylvania.
Former McDonald's franchise owner. Chair of the Republican Study Committee. Focused on free-market healthcare reforms, opposing single-payer systems, and expanding health savings accounts.
Represents southern West Virginia, an area heavily impacted by the opioid crisis. Advocate for substance abuse treatment funding, rural hospital preservation, and Medicaid work requirements.

Practicing physician (urologist) and only MD on the Republican side of the committee. Brings clinical perspective to healthcare policy. Advocate for physician payment reform and reducing administrative burden.
Former U.S. Attorney. Focused on combating healthcare fraud, opioid enforcement, and healthcare tax policy. Represents western Tennessee.
Co-chair of the Problem Solvers Caucus. One of the most bipartisan Republicans. Supports surprise billing protections, mental health funding, and bipartisan drug pricing negotiations.
Army veteran focused on veterans' healthcare access, opposing vaccine mandates, and reducing FDA regulatory barriers. Represents southwestern Florida.
Focused on healthcare affordability in upstate New York, opposing hospital monopolies, and supporting community health centers and rural clinics.
Former Minnesota Lieutenant Governor. Focused on rural healthcare, agricultural worker health, and mental health access in underserved communities.
Vice Chair of the Republican Conference. Focused on healthcare innovation, health data interoperability, and expanding telehealth access.
Former Irving, TX mayor. Focused on healthcare price transparency, reducing surprise billing, and healthcare tax deductions for families.
Former Iowa state senator. Focused on rural hospital viability, telehealth for agricultural communities, and reducing prescription drug costs.
Represents Staten Island and southern Brooklyn. Focused on Medicare Part B costs, prescription drug affordability, and healthcare access in urban communities.
Energy industry background. Focused on healthcare tax policy, employer-sponsored coverage, and reducing ACA marketplace costs.
Business executive background. Focused on healthcare competition, price transparency, and reducing healthcare regulatory burden for employers.
Former White House advisor. Focused on veterans' healthcare, mental health services for first responders, and healthcare innovation policy.
Former Florida state senator. Focused on Medicaid reform, healthcare workforce shortages, and reducing hospital pricing opacity in northeast Florida.
Former county judge. Focused on rural healthcare access in east Texas, community health centers, and Medicaid managed care reform.
Ranking Member and former Chairman of Ways and Means. Led passage of ACA premium subsidies and drug pricing provisions. Senior voice on Medicare and Medicaid policy.
Ranking Member of the Health Subcommittee. Leading voice on drug pricing reform, Medicare negotiation, and pharmaceutical industry oversight. Longest-serving Democrat on the committee.
Vietnam veteran. Focused on veterans' healthcare, ACA marketplace improvements, and mental health parity. Senior member with deep healthcare policy expertise.
Champion of Social Security expansion. Focused on Medicare solvency, prescription drug costs, and healthcare coverage for seniors. Author of Social Security 2100 Act.
Represents Chicago's West Side. Focused on health equity, Medicaid expansion, community health centers, and addressing healthcare disparities in underserved communities.
Focused on healthcare access for working families, children's health insurance, and mental health services. Advocate for expanding Medicaid and CHIP.
Focused on rural healthcare access in Alabama's Black Belt, Medicaid expansion, and maternal health. Advocates for closing the coverage gap in non-expansion states.
Chair of the New Democrat Coalition. Tech industry background. Focused on health IT, telehealth expansion, and ACA marketplace stability.
Chair of the Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus. Focused on mental health funding, health equity for AAPI communities, and reducing healthcare costs.
Represents Milwaukee. Focused on Medicaid, maternal health, health equity, and addressing healthcare costs for low-income families.
Former Ranking Member of the Budget Committee. Focused on Medicare and Social Security solvency, healthcare costs, and ACA protections for pre-existing conditions.
Former Ambassador to Switzerland. Business owner focused on healthcare tax policy, ACA improvements, and healthcare cost transparency.
Veteran Philadelphia legislator. Focused on community health centers, health equity, food-as-medicine programs, and addressing healthcare deserts in urban areas.
Business consultant background. Focused on ACA protections, prescription drug affordability, and mental health parity in insurance coverage.
Son of former Defense Secretary Leon Panetta. Focused on veterans' healthcare, agricultural worker health, and expanding community health center funding on the Central Coast.
Represents downtown Los Angeles. Focused on Medicaid, maternal health, environmental health impacts, and healthcare access for immigrant communities.
Chair of the Congressional Black Caucus. Focused on health equity, Medicaid expansion, hospital workforce shortages, and healthcare access in rural Nevada.
Delegate from the U.S. Virgin Islands. Focused on healthcare access in territories, Medicaid funding parity, and disaster healthcare preparedness.
Former Nassau County Executive. Focused on healthcare costs on Long Island, SALT deductions impacting healthcare affordability, and Medicare prescription drug negotiations.
